## T6. Cross-word deviation: nulls and cluster-bootstrap 95% CIs (B=1000)

Null A: isotropic unit vectors in R^d (the paper's original baseline). Null B: spectrum-matched Gaussian, N(0, Σ) with Σ the empirical covariance of the protocol centroids, normalized (word labels kept). d_eff: median deviation of isotropic vectors in PR dimensions, asin(0.6745/√PR). CIs: percentile bootstrap resampling words (2000 clusters; same-word pairs are excluded so every pair has expected weight 1) and a delete-one-block jackknife (500 blocks of 4 words sharing a cue pool; a block bootstrap over-weights within-block pairs 2× and is not used).
